[4:26PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

 There is slow movement on the CMS bridge heading towards Offin Canal Market, specifically impacted by vehicles entering and exiting the market area. However, the stretch immediately following Offin Canal Market to the Ijora Olopa by NEPA intersection is currently clear.

Similarly, Broad Street is experiencing slow and steady movement extending to Apongbon underneath the bridge. This congestion affects connections to Offin Canal Market and Olowogbowo, again attributed to ongoing market operations and the typical closing hour rush. 

In contrast, traffic is flowing smoothly on Eko Bridge by the NEPA intersection towards Apongbon. Additionally, descending Eko Bridge towards CMS, the Elegbeta Mini Stadium, and Ebute-Ero Market areas are experiencing good movement. 

The route from Ebute-Ero Market inward Leventis, through the UBA roundabout, and connecting to both inner and outer Marina is also clear. Our personnel are visible and actively managing the flow to minimize impediments.

#FollowLASTMA
